correctness.rationale: All six exact squared distance shells are computed from fourteen integer coordinates. The first complex is a connected 24-edge graph of rank 11; the second triangulates the convex rhombic-dodecahedral sphere; the third has a verified explicit 80-pair simplicial collapse onto the eight-corner four-pair cross-polytope boundary S3; the fourth is the join of seven S0 factors (S6); the fifth has a cone vertex. The standalone checker replays each global pair as a free-face collapse in its then-current face set, checks all face counts, and independently computes mod-two Betti numbers. The integral homotopy types imply exactly the claimed positive-degree bar endpoints.

value.rationale: The rhombic dodecahedron is the natural fourteen-vertex Catalan dual of the well-studied cuboctahedron, so its exact Euclidean point-cloud Rips filtration is a structurally motivated invariant. The new classification features sphere dimensions 1,2,3,6 and a nontrivial 80-collapse intermediate 3-sphere, not a generic rank computation or arbitrary slice. Complete integral homotopy stages yield the persistence barcode across all real scales and complement the different filtration of its dual.
